heading: INT. COUNTY COURTHOUSE, SMALL CLAIMS - DAY

units.text: INT. COUNTY COURTHOUSE, SMALL CLAIMS - DAY
Fluorescent lights.
A radiator knocking.
Four chairs and a table.
A MAN in a rumpled tan jacket sits alone at the defendant's table, studying his own thumbs.
JUDGE PRISCILLA OYELOWO-HART (60s) enters, sits, and bangs the gavel once.
We're on the record. Counsel for the plaintiff?
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: FELIPE ARRIAGA (30s, bright tie) rises.
Felipe Arriaga, Your Honor.
units.name: FELIPE

units.text: And the defendant?
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: Just me, ma'am.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Name for the record.
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: Dutch Halloran.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Mr. Halloran, you're unrepresented?
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: Yes, ma'am. I figured the truth doesn't need a lawyer.
units.name: DUTCH

units.text: It usually needs one.
units.name: JUDGE

units.text: At the back of the room, CLERK BARNABY SKOLNICK (50s) stifles a laugh.
Felipe sits and Dutch rises at the same moment.
Your Honor, my client withdraws the claim.
units.name: FELIPE

units.text: Your Honor, I'd like to pay it.
units.name: DUTCH

units.text: The Judge looks from one to the other.
She sighs and lowers the gavel.
Nobody leaves until I understand why.
units.name: JUDGE
